Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts (lines 72-91), the Salesforce integration directly calls `fetch('https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token', ...)` without wrapping it in `refreshOAuthTokens()` like all other integrations do (Google Calendar, HubSpot, Office365, Zoom, etc.). This is inconsistent with the pattern established for other integrations in this PR and would prevent Salesforce from working with the credential sync feature.
